research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class Imbalance
bullets: Implemented assigned logistic regression and probability calibration routines using scikit-learn, following existing specifications for stratified training and validation splits.
Generated reliability diagrams and summarized Brier scores across prescribed class sampling settings, checking preprocessing consistency and documenting implementation discrepancies.

work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming shipments against packing lists, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed damaged items for review under established receiving procedures.
Prepared daily order paperwork, maintained physical filing records, and coordinated pickup schedules with staff to support routine fulfillment activities.

projects.title: Regularized Regression for Rental Price Prediction
bullets: Implemented ordinary least squares and ridge regression baselines for rental price prediction, using training data to fit imputation and scaling steps.
Compared validation errors across prescribed regularization settings and inspected residual plots to describe prediction patterns across rental price ranges.
